page.overview:
Who is Cellibotti?

Cellibotti is a Tilean painter who immortalised Monna Lissa in one of his portraits. Taking that portrait as a model for a battle standard depicting Myrmidia, the goddess of war and strategy, is now considered a good omen for many mercenary companies.

Cellibotti is an obvious pun on the real world Italian painter [https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Sandro_Botticelli Botticelli].
